_comment: Official, dated figures per city that the China skills quote (the severance cap, social insurance bases). Every number carries its source URL and the date it takes effect. Add a city only from an official notice (人社局, 医保局, 税务局, 统计局); a figure from a news or law-firm summary is not enough. Rendered at web/city-data.html; reviewed each summer through data/cn-policy-calendar.json (social-insurance-base, average-wage).

socialInsuranceBase.covers: 职工基本养老保险、失业保险、工伤保险、职工基本医疗保险（含生育）

avgMonthlyWage.note: The notice does not print the average; the upper limit is 300% of it, so it is about 36348 / 3 = 12116 yuan. Use the official figure when the 统计局 or 人社局 publishes it.

socialInsuranceBase.covers: 社保缴费基数（养老、医疗、失业、工伤、生育）

avgMonthlyWage.note: 本市 2025 年度全口径城镇单位就业人员平均工资
